request.what: Info action to agree a new Net Change Limit for Cardano Treasury withdrawals for Epochs 613-713

claims.claim: The proposal sets a Net Change Limit of 500,000,000 ada, equal to 500,000,000,000,000 lovelace, for Cardano Treasury withdrawals during Epochs 613-713.
The proposed period begins at the start of Epoch 613 on February 13, 2026 and ends at the close of Epoch 713 on or about July 3, 2027.
The limit caps only total lovelace removed from the Treasury by enacted Treasury Withdrawals recorded on the Cardano ledger and does not count Treasury inflows.
All Treasury Withdrawals already debited during the period count toward the proposed 500,000,000 ada limit.
The proposal supersedes any prior Net Change Limit for the same Epochs 613-713 period.
The document says the existing 350,000,000 ada Net Change Limit has been useful but practical remaining room under it is becoming constrained.
The action has no direct on-chain effect and does not authorize any Treasury Withdrawal.
The proposer asserts the action complies with the enacted Cardano Constitution version 2.4 and Appendix I Guardrails, and provides an IPFS reference to that constitution.
The proposer asserts that nothing in the Constitution limits DReps to a single Net Change Limit or prevents a newly agreed Net Change Limit from applying to the period.

summary: The anchor document proposes an Info action to replace the existing Epochs 613-713 Treasury Net Change Limit with a 500,000,000 ada cap, using ledger-debited withdrawals only and preserving separate approval for individual Treasury Withdrawals.
